# strike drawer

Panel: Brand/Art Director, UX and conversion, Motion Designer, Front-end/a11y/performance engineer, Devil's-advocate creative director. Nothing in this file shipped from a round that scored under 8.

Travel is translateX for every theme, which the devil accepted as drawer travel. The arrival mark is this theme's own. Glyphs rotateX from -90 to 0, 90ms linear, stagger 16ms. Toast and modal are a vertical shutter. The form rule translates 4px on Y onto the baseline in crimson. The drawer title flaps. Crimson is never a fill.


## Round 1
The first bold slate did not converge. Art scored a free editor and shared effects under 8. UX scored missing 44px targets and moving labels under 8. The engineer blocked white-on-crimson and Lagoon blur. The devil blocked the form and overlay set. Nothing from that round was implemented.

## Round 2, the locked spec
Art: Lagoon 9, Strike 9, Rally 9, Orrery 9 after the rim fix, Array 8 after the tick was kept off the ice stroke. Button, toast, modal, and editor 9.
UX: themes 8–9. Toast moved from 7 to 9 once Pause was a 44px control that freezes the shell.
Motion: every theme 8–9. Similarity: none. The five properties stay disc, flap, shell tilt, squash, and scaleX.
Engineer: themes and kit 8–9. The editor guard scored 9 once text was 4.5:1 and mark, success, warn, and danger were 3:1 against background, surface, and text.
Devil: ship, 8 or 9, with spotlight, beams, magnetic targets, shimmer, and a shared spinner kept out.


## Implementation gate
Art scored the shipping controls 8 to 10 and passed.
UX blocked preset restore at 4, then scored it 8 after a preset button writes theme, scheme, intensity, colors, radius, and type pair back through the contrast guard.
Motion blocked the editorial and technical underlines at 6 while both were scaleX. After the editorial rule became a 4px Y translation and the Rally shell became a real squash, the rescore was editorial 9, technical 8, Rally input 9. Similarity: none.
Engineer passed contrast, WebGL demand frames, select keys, toast buttons, and one-timer demos at 8 or 9. Calendar arrow keys were recorded as a gap, not a failure.
Devil vetoed a shared drawer with no mark, an unmarked date cell, a raw file input, and a Rally scale of 0.98. After the marks were painted where they can be seen, the final scores were drawer 9, Rally input 9, file 9, date cell 9, kit 9. Ship.
